name: Turkey chili
ingredients:
1 lb ground turkey
1 onion, diced
2 cloves garlic
2 (15 oz) cans black beans
1 can diced tomatoes
2 tbsp chili powder
1 tsp cumin
steps:
Brown the turkey with the onion and garlic.
Add the beans, tomatoes and spices.
Simmer 30 minutes.
